public_rationale: Zitron's summary matches the Goldman Sachs report (Top of Mind, Issue 129, June 2024). Covello says he sat through hundreds of smartphone presentations in the early 2000s, and that much of it played out as the industry expected. He gives GPS as an example. He then says a roadmap of what the technology would do existed from the start, and that no comparable roadmap exists today for AI. 'Fully telegraphed' is a little stronger than Covello's 'much of it'. Whether AI truly lacks a roadmap is a judgment and is not scored here.
limitations: Two-column PDF text is interleaved in the extraction, so the quotes read awkwardly.
Only the faithfulness of the summary is scored, not whether Covello's view is correct.
